doi_waiver_policy.policy: DOI is not a mandatory field when the reference is user-provided, has a verified complete paper PDF fulltext, or is verifiably discoverable in a public academic index such as Google Scholar, OpenAlex, CNKI, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, a publisher or journal page, or an institutional repository. If a DOI is present in the evidence, verify it; never fabricate a DOI.

pdf_fulltext_waiver.policy: A verified complete paper PDF fulltext is one accepted DOI-waiver basis. Record file source, first-page or metadata match, title, author or source match, year or source match, page count, and readability. If a DOI is present in the PDF or companion metadata, verify it; never fabricate a DOI.

formal_reference_policy: Formal academic references must be verified before delivery. DOI is a strong verification basis, but it is not the only pass condition. A reference may pass without DOI when at least one approved DOI-waiver basis is recorded: user-provided source evidence, verified complete paper PDF fulltext, or a public academic index record from Google Scholar, OpenAlex, CNKI, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, a publisher or journal page, or an institutional repository. Every passing reference still needs author, year, title, source, verification source, verification basis, and auditable evidence. If a DOI is present in the evidence, verify it; never fabricate a DOI.
